newsitem.title: CHINA: Everbright Bank of China to set US$64 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Everbright Bank of China to set US$64 mln loan.

text.p: Everbright Bank of China will launch a US$64 million syndicated loan on Thursday, the loan arrangers said.
The facility has a final maturity of five years and pays a margin of 46 basis points over the one-, three- or six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Repayment will be in four equal semi-annual installments commencing at the end of 3.5 years from the loan agreement date.
The loan is fully underwritten by the arrangers, Bayerische Landesbank, Chase Manhattan Asia, Deutsche Bank and ING Barings.
Major shareholders of the bank are China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd and China Everbright Group, which is controlled by China's State Council.
